notes: Original English learning scenarios using only indexed phrases from the existing unapproved 16-phrase draft. Dialogue ordering, appropriateness, variants, translations and spelling require fluent review. These are NOT live lessons, audio scripts or evidence of CHamoru accuracy.
help_policy: Offer a hint about task instructions, never a submitted independent-answer key.

scenarios.title: A morning meeting
scenarios.english_context: Two neighbors meet in the morning, exchange greetings, and express thanks.
scenarios.independent_prompt: After the context disappears, recall a greeting and a courteous closing without choosing from a list.

scenarios.title: A friendly arrival
scenarios.english_context: A visitor is greeted and someone asks a simple question. Dialogue order is provisional.
scenarios.independent_prompt: Identify which expression asks for a name, then type its meaning from memory.

scenarios.title: An afternoon exchange
scenarios.english_context: Practice recognizing a time-of-day greeting and distinguishing affirmative and negative replies. Dialogue order is provisional.
scenarios.independent_prompt: Recall both response words without seeing the CHamoru spelling.

scenarios.title: An evening goodbye
scenarios.english_context: Two people end an evening encounter with farewell expressions. Dialogue order is provisional.
scenarios.independent_prompt: Reconstruct a possible farewell sequence, then type the meaning of each phrase.
